text: For #440, the watcher checks a step on what it tracks. It maps an issue onto `factory/protocol`'s initial state, and takes a step when one of the model's next states agrees with the issue's next view on every field the watcher tracks, so a core that keeps more than the watcher does, as #439's keeps decision follow-ups and the person who merged a pull request, has the steps it had. The repository's tests of locks ratified by hand check every such lock git tracks, at least one, instead of naming them.
